lines.text: It’s project time! Run linear and binary search on the same sorted list of 100 numbers, count the steps each takes for several targets, and report which is more efficient — with each search in its own procedure.
Make a sorted list of 100 numbers.
For a target, run linear search and binary search, count the steps of each, and report both.
Put each search in its own My Block with the target as the input.
Your main script just calls them.
Same list, same target, same counting rule (one step per comparison).
Try several targets: small, middle, large, missing.
Write what you found: which was faster, by how much, and when the difference matters most.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
